data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Marina represents the goddess of the sea. She is known for her calming presence, strength, and nurturing nature. Marina is believed to protect sailors and fishermen and bring prosperity to coastal communities. The name Marina carries the meaning “Sea Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Marina usually hope their child will grow to embody sea goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
